subject: showcase
caption:
Most people picture one card. This one ran to eight pages.

The invitation, the save the date, the entourage across three pages, the mass offerors, the attire guide, the timeline. Names blurred here because they belong to the families, not to our feed.

This is where the cost of an invitation actually goes. Not the paper — the eight pages that have to look like they came from the same hand.

Send us your event date and we will tell you what yours would need.
